title: Heat Pump Cost Comparison: Winter heating vs. Gas Furnace
summary: A Las Vegas homeowner compares a winter on gas furnaces with a winter on ducted variable-speed heat pumps: dearer at standard rates, cheaper on time-of-use with solar.

assertions.quote: in total there was 18 states where gas is cheaper and 33 states for electricity and the heat pump is cheaper
electricity at the standard rate 11 more expensive than heating with gas
i'm on a time of use rate plan
in my case i'm not paying the standard rate i have solar and i also have battery storage
it's much more expensive when you're heating with traditional heat strips
we wanted something much quieter more efficient and variable speed
